provenance.notes: Hard-tier charged-messengers pair (08-PROPOSALS.md Set 5, APPROVED 2026-09-26): glutamic acid + acetylcholine CID 187 (+1 quaternary N - the DEFAULT approved pick; imidazolium CID 444234 and tetramethylammonium CID 6380 alternates NOT substituted). Per-record citation per U1: 'PubChem Identifier: CID <CID>; URL: https://pubchem.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/compound/<CID>'. Complex reference metadata: CC0 1.0 (wwPDB). AMENDED 2026-10-05 (human PHYSIOLOGICAL-PROTONATION decision '2 go R1-R8', 08.1-08 protonation audit row 7, directive: 'per our spec we want to assume physiological pH normally' — the decision SUPERSEDES the C3 free-acid/Decision-5-parallel policy now that the audit verified a clean stereo-explicit 3D route): glutamic acid CID 33032 neutral free acid -> L-glutamate zwitterion CID 5460299 (net -1: 2x carboxylate -1 + alpha-NH3+ +1; pK1 2.19 / pK2 4.25 / pK3 9.67 Merck 2013 via the CID 33032 record; (2S) stereo-explicit matches shipped L). Rejected candidates recorded in the audit: 5128032 (wrong bare dianion with neutral NH2), 4525487 (stereo-unspecified twin). The zwitterion covers BOTH salt-bridge signs (additive to acetylcholine's '+' slot).

L-Glutamate zwitterion, PubChem CID 5460299 ((2S)-2-azaniumylpentanedioate, C5H8NO4-, 10 heavy, Charge -1 as recorded: 2x carboxylate -1 M CHG + 1x alpha-NH3+ +1 M CHG; stereo-explicit (2S) matches the shipped L form). Complex: 2JFO Enterococcus faecalis glutamate racemase with D- and L-glutamate (GLU confirmed as a bound nonpolymer ligand - hits 2CT6/1J0F rejected at confirmation, verified 2026-09-26; paper DOI resolves 200). Carries salt_bridge in BOTH directions (two deprotonated carboxylates '-' AND the alpha-ammonium '+' - the zwitterion covers both signs; the NH3+ also types '+' structurally per capability's ammonium rule), h_bond rich (NH3+ donor; carboxylate O acceptors), hydrophobic (C3 spacer). AMENDED 2026-10-05 (human decision '2 go R1-R8', audit row 7/R5, directive 'per our spec we want to assume physiological pH normally'): was CID 33032 neutral free acid (Charge 0 as recorded per approved C3 - the research's '-1' claim is INCORRECT for THAT CID; 19 atoms {1:16,2:2}); swapped to the physiological zwitterion (COO- x2 ~100%: pK1 2.19 / pK2 4.25; NH3+ 99.5%: pK3 9.67 - Merck 2013 via the CID 33032 record). Rejected candidates: 5128032 (wrong bare dianion, neutral N), 4525487 (stereo-unspecified twin) - do NOT use. Prior prose said 'this set's salt-bridge slot is acetylcholine' - the zwitterion is now BOTH-sign-capable (additive; acetylcholine keeps its '+' slot). Neutral CID 33032 record stays in git history.

Acetylcholine, PubChem CID 187 (C7H16NO2+, 10 heavy, Charge +1 as recorded - permanently charged quaternary ammonium; no pKa choice exists). The DEFAULT approved pick over imidazolium CID 444234 (both 3D-verified during 08-04). Complex: 9E3E Torpedo nicotinic acetylcholine receptor, diliganded (ACH confirmed in inventory - eight higher-ranked hits lacked ACH, walk recorded, verified 2026-09-26; paper DOI verified at rcsb.org, doi.org 403 bot-block per U2). Carries salt_bridge (permanently +1 quaternary N vs AA carboxylates - the set's salt-bridge carrier), cation_pi ligand-side (the NMe3+ quaternary case sits OUTSIDE the PLIP tertamine veto - veto requires exactly 3 non-H substituents; the boundary complement to guanidinium's boundary case), h_bond (carbonyl + ester O acceptors), hydrophobic.
